items.title: Yggdrasil is now Toskar
items.text: Same engine, new name. Existing installs keep their data, settings, and paired computers, and Homebrew and apt move them over on the next upgrade.

items.title: Your connected apps keep working
items.text: API keys, MCP settings in Claude Desktop, Cursor, and VS Code, webhooks, and YGGDRASIL_ variables all still work, so nothing you connected needs changing.

items.title: Chat picks up where you left off
items.text: Leave Chat for another page and come back, and the conversation you were in reopens, context gauge and all, instead of starting over.

items.title: Private AI on your iPhone
items.text: Toskar Mobile can run a smaller model on the phone itself, look things up on the web with its sources, and keep its memories on the phone.

items.title: The same chat choices on the phone
items.text: Auto, the profile, which computer answers, effort, and memory: the iPhone app offers the chat options the web UI has.

items.title: One Toskar per computer
items.text: When another Toskar already runs on this computer, the desktop app says so instead of quietly showing the other one's models and chats.
